{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Black wool sheath dress, knee-length cut, solid matte black (hex #000000), heavy woven wool with a subtle herringbone texture.
Cream silk blouse, classic pointed collar, relaxed fit, pale cream (hex #FFFDD0), smooth satin weave.
Charcoal grey tailored blazer, structured shoulders, single-button closure, waist-length jacket, dark charcoal grey (hex #36454F), sharp wool blend with fine pinstripes.
Black leather pumps, pointed toe, 7-centimeter heel, glossy finish, calfskin leather (hex #1A1A1A).
Black silk opera gloves, elbow-length, satin weave, deep black (hex #0B0B0B), smooth and slightly stiffened cotton blend lining.

This ensemble meets the formal dress code required for an evening at the theatre by combining a structured blazer with a refined sheath dress and elegant pumps. The addition of silk opera gloves elevates the look to a ceremonial level, perfectly honoring the traditional atmosphere of a classic stage performance. All pieces are crafted from premium, dark fabrics suitable for autumn weather, ensuring warmth without sacrificing the polished silhouette needed for such an occasion."}
